extension.summary: Two subtitle tracks at once, chosen during playback
extension.description: Shows two subtitle tracks of the video playing at the same time, each with its own style, position and timing, from Jellyfin or from files next to the video. Kodi draws them, so the video keeps playing directly. Long-press the Subtitle, Menu, C or L key during playback to choose.
